name: console-default-preview
goal: Default Console previews show the settled catalog capture while loading states remain selectable.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Active prepared main a34 selects loading-history for the Console through the real catalogShot(evidence, unit.preview, true) card call. Its definition has no preferred preview. Expected default is the settled dedicated catalog capture; loading history/revision states remain available.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing every-dedicated-visual-catalog-card test forces a state pick and supplies only default captures, so it misses the no-preview actual caller and loading captures recorded first. Strengthen that existing registry-wide case with real Console loading states and exact caller selection; retain strict per-device and rejected-evidence assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test-only f8ce3c10a, record 2cc2db98 reproduces the actual Console default caller choosing loading-history instead of its settled capture; the other standardized cases pass. Test inputs preflight format/lint/types/audit pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reviewed Console as the visual routing component that renders ExplorerLayout, loading notices and the supplied screen, without a children slot. Correct its single legacy shell declaration to component and declare the settled catalog preview. Stable ID and existing component category are preserved; no classifier, selector or provenance rule changes. Normal units index canonicalizes metadata order.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired same-environment red 6c5f4e5e at f8ce3c10a selects loading-history and green 3523105d at 0a05219ca selects the settled default. The existing test corpus/command is unchanged; all four standardized cases pass, six Console loading captures remain available, and all registered device preview choices still resolve. Registry1461/93 and fourteen unchanged readable-contract/ownership guards pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
